title: Access mode (access tier)
description: A way of knowing, not a domain of the world. f01-f20 are domains OF the world; an access entry is a domain of REPRESENTATIONS of it, or a route by which a reading is obtained. Different tier, not a further face. STATUS: MARKER UNDER EXPLORATION — not a settled ontology, expected to change after experiment, not to be enforced as an invariant. The access tier admits new members without restructuring; that is the requirement, not a limitation. There is deliberately no face_assignment, no fixed count, no polytope closure and no duality or incidence check here, and no solid is to be re-derived from the number of files present.

id.description: Tier-local id, e.g. a01. Lowercase, as specified.

rosetta_id.description: Dot-namespaced form for the code tables and the id registry. Repo convention bridge; the tier-local id above is the one the spec names.

channel.description: residual: the world pushed back on your own reading. transmitted: taught or given, carrying the source's observer without the receipts. unmarked: not recorded — legitimate, and expected to dominate. none: no new input at all — the mode checks held items against each other.

operation.description: What the access actually does. One line.

valid_on.description: Conditions under which it holds. One line or a list.

breaks_when.description: MANDATORY, may not be null or empty. An access entry with no stated break point is a preference, not an access mode, and is rejected at validation. One line or a list.

lands_on.description: Which confidence tier the output claims. Cheap travel to an expensive destination is the detector: cost=free with lands_on=measured is a mismatch worth a warning, and no judgement term is needed to say so.

receipt_recoverable.description: THE DISCRIMINATOR. Cost does not separate a01 from a03 — both are cheap to acquire and both land on 'measured', so the cost-mismatch flag fires on both and cannot tell them apart. What separates them is whether you can, in principle, walk back to a residual event. in_principle: the source paid and receipts exist upstream, they just did not travel with the holding — transmission with lost receipts. none: nobody paid anywhere and no upstream receipt exists to recover — narrative. in_fact: recoverable and the path is still recorded. n/a: the mode takes no input, so there is nothing to walk back to.

carries.description: What arrives with the holding. A mode that carries content and the source's observer but not the receipts is the shape of transmission.

sub_modes.description: Variants sharing the channel. Kept inside one entry rather than split out, so that a variant which arrived the same way keeps its lineage visible even when it sits at a different position in the stack.

uptake_maintained_by.description: What keeps this channel open at the receiver. An access mode with no maintenance requirement stated is assumed permanently available, which is the uptake-decay blind spot written into the schema.

uptake_decays_when.description: What closes the channel at the receiver — with the referent unchanged, the emission unchanged, and the holding untouched in the record.

derived_from.description: Prior id this entry was filed under, kept so the old slug still resolves. A slug carries a content pointer and a record of which gate it got past; a move that drops the pointer orphans the second.

provenance.description: Added beyond the tier spec's field list: this repo does not ship a record without one. See src/rosetta_shape_core/provenance.py.
